name: My Pet Rider
source:
Chapter 2 of My pet series Fate edition.
Rider turns out to be fun and good at cooking. But past does not come away easily. She gets confined and deprived of personality. Humiliation and gangbang change each other. What will remain of her?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《我的宠物》系列《Fate》篇第2章。
Rider意外地有趣，而且很擅长烹饪。然而过去并不会轻易放过她。她遭到囚禁，人格也被逐渐剥夺；羞辱与轮奸交替上演。最后的她还能剩下什么？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
